units.source_text: 或许，这是为了让你和新娘子能安乐地生活。

en.t: Perhaps this was so that you and your bride could live in peace and comfort.

units.source_text: 我害怕自己那种能够超越时空发挥作用的灵魂的力量，才把灵魂的门扉关闭的。

en.t: I closed the door of my soul because I feared the power of my own spirit, the kind that could act beyond time and space.
